::: {.callout-warning}
## Human approval required

This page records open decisions. It does not establish institutional policy or authorize a storage system, classification scheme, retention period, release process, or use of generative AI.
:::

The owner, evidence, status, and review point below are role-based placeholders. No named individuals are assigned.

| Decision | Question requiring approval | Proposed decision owner | Authoritative evidence location | Decision status | Target review point |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Data classification | What institutional terms and handling rules apply to public, internal, restricted, confidential, PII, proprietary, governed, and sensitive ecological/geographical data? | Data steward; information security; privacy authority | USDA, laboratory, information-security, privacy, and data-governance policy | Open | Before standard approval |
| Approved storage | Which local, institutional, cloud, OSF, or repository systems are approved for each class of data? | Information security; data steward | Institutional storage and security guidance | Open | Before project adoption |
| Backups | What backup frequency, locations, restore testing, and responsibility are required? | Information security; records management | IT backup and recovery guidance | Open | Before operational use |
| Cloud services | Which cloud services and regions are acceptable for research data, credentials, and outputs? | Information security; contracts authority | Security, contracts, and funder terms | Open | Before cloud use |
| Retention | What minimum retention periods and destruction/archival rules apply by project and record type? | Records management | Records-management, funder, publication, and legal requirements | Open | Before closeout policy |
| Public repositories | Which public repositories are approved for code, data, metadata, and releases? | Lab leadership; data steward | Institutional repository and funder guidance | Open | Before external release |
| Sensitive spatial data | How should locations be generalized, masked, access-controlled, or withheld? | Data steward; privacy authority; Indigenous governance authority | Data agreements, ethics, Indigenous governance, and security requirements | Open | Before spatial release |
| Personally identifiable information | What collection, storage, linkage, de-identification, access, and destruction controls apply? | Privacy authority; information security | Privacy/IRB and institutional policy | Open | Before PII handling |
| Dependency locking | What minimum environment record is required for exploratory, publication, operational, and HPC projects? | Technical reviewer; lab leadership | Lab technical review and project risk criteria | Open | Before standard approval |
| External-release review | Who must review code, data, figures, licenses, security, and limitations before release? | Project lead; technical reviewer; lab leadership | Publisher, funder, security, and institutional release requirements | Open | Before external release |
| Exceptions | Who can approve an exception and how long can it remain open? | Lab leadership; institutional authority | Institutional governance and applicable legal/security rules | Open | Before standard approval |
| Licensing | What default licenses and attribution/citation requirements apply to code, data, documentation, and assets? | Lab leadership; contracts authority | Institution, funder, and data-provider terms | Open | Before public release |
| Contributors and authorship | How are contributions, acknowledgements, authorship, and maintenance responsibilities determined? | Lab leadership | Lab authorship and contributor guidance | Open | Before publication |
| Records management | Which project artifacts are official records, and how are they archived or disposed of? | Records management | Institutional records-management requirements | Open | Before closeout policy |
| Generative AI | What uses of generative AI are permitted in research documentation and code development, and what disclosure, review, privacy, and provenance are required? | Lab leadership; information security; privacy authority; publisher/funder authority | Institution, funder, publisher, security, and lab policy | Open | Before AI-assisted release |

## Interim treatment

Record applicable restrictions without inventing official labels. Use the approved system named by the data owner or agreement. Do not upload restricted data, PII, credentials, unpublished confidential material, or protected research content to an unapproved service. Preserve upstream license terms and record uncertainty. Legal, privacy, security, contractual, and institutional requirements cannot be waived by a project exception.

Until approved, each item should receive an evidence-backed decision, decision date, and review date. The proposed standard should then be revised rather than silently converting assumptions into policy.
